blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: The girl playing the piano is named Akiko.
exercises.why: **играть → играющую** — present active participle: 3rd person plural without -т + -щ- + adjective ending.

exercises.q: Джим поскользнулся на ___ (обледенеть) дорожке и ударился.
exercises.prompt: Jim slipped on the icy road and got hurt.
exercises.why: **обледенеть → обледеневшей** — past active participle: past stem + -вш- (after a vowel) or -ш- (after a consonant) + adjective ending.

exercises.prompt: An exomoon is a moon that orbits around an exoplanet.
exercises.why: **вращаться → вращающийся** — present active participle: 3rd person plural without -т + -щ- + adjective ending.
**устать → уставший** — past active participle: past stem + -вш- (after a vowel) or -ш- (after a consonant) + adjective ending.

exercises.prompt: Tom is an Albanian studying in Australia.
exercises.why: **учиться → учащийся** — present active participle: 3rd person plural without -т + -щ- + adjective ending.

exercises.q: Только ___ (играть) в Майнкрафт знают, кто такие свинозомби.
exercises.prompt: Only people who play Minecraft know what zombie pigmen are.
exercises.why: **играть → игравшие** — past active participle: past stem + -вш- (after a vowel) or -ш- (after a consonant) + adjective ending.

exercises.prompt: I saw some birds flying away.
exercises.why: **улетать → улетающих** — present active participle: 3rd person plural without -т + -щ- + adjective ending.

exercises.prompt: Latecomers are subject to a penalty.
exercises.why: **опоздать → Опоздавшим** — past active participle: past stem + -вш- (after a vowel) or -ш- (after a consonant) + adjective ending.
